"""Build work/network.json by reasoning: every weight is a physics formula or a chosen literal.

Run:  ./python3 work/build_network.py
No image is read here.  See work/NETWORK.md for the account of every unit.

Notation (KIT section 4/5): x = sample point, v = view ray direction (camera -> point), s = toward-sun
unit vector, mu = v.s.  The network outputs (a_sun, a_sky, a_gnd) per channel; the renderer multiplies them
by E_sun, L_sky, L_gnd.  All our outputs are grey (the medium is achromatic), so each triple repeats one value.
"""
import json, math

SIG = 0.04                   # sigma_max, 1/m
FOURPI = 4 * math.pi
G1, G2, W1 = 0.9, -0.3, 0.8  # phase function lobes


def hg_const(g):
    """log of the (1-g^2)/(4 pi) prefactor of HG(mu; g)."""
    return math.log((1 - g * g) / FOURPI)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- probes
probes, P = [], {}


def probe(name, spec):
    P[name] = len(probes)
    probes.append(spec)


# (1) fine optical depth toward the sun: midpoint rule on geometrically growing segments.
#     The direct beam only matters for tau < ~6, i.e. the first few hundred metres.
fine_edges = [0, 10, 25, 50, 90, 150, 240, 370, 550]
fine = []
for a, b in zip(fine_edges[:-1], fine_edges[1:]):
    n = f"fine_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": max(b - a, 7)})
    fine.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (2) coarse optical depth toward the sun at the diffusion scale: the blur (>= 150 m, a few transport mean
#     free paths) averages the sun exposure over the neighbourhood that feeds a point by diffusion.
#     Reach 1400 m covers the whole cloud.
cone_edges = [0, 60, 160, 320, 560, 900, 1400]
cone_blur = [150, 200, 280, 380, 500, 700]
cone = []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(cone_edges[:-1], cone_edges[1:]), cone_blur):
    n = f"cone_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    cone.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (3) enclosure: box-filtered density around x at three scales
probe("E150", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 150})
probe("E300", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 300})
probe("E600", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 600})
# (4) large-scale density gradient along the sun direction (cosine of incidence on the lit cap)
probe("s_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("s_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (5) large-scale density gradient along the view ray (am I looking into the cloud from outside?)
probe("v_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("v_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (6) optical depth straight up (sky) and straight down (ground)
ud_edges = [0, 15, 40, 90, 180, 350, 650]
ud_blur = [15, 25, 50, 90, 170, 300]
up, dn = [], []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(ud_edges[:-1], ud_edges[1:]), ud_blur):
    n = f"up_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    up.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
    n = f"dn_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    dn.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (7) vertical large-scale gradient (top surface vs base)
probe("y_below", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("y_above", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (8) scalars
probe("mu", {"type": "cos_view_sun"})
probe("vy", {"type": "view_up"})
probe("one", {"type": "const", "value": 1.0})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer builder
layers = []          # list of dicts with W, b, act
names = [dict(P)]    # name -> index per layer (layer 0 = probes)


def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():
            row[prev[k]] += w
        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)

    lin("tau_c", dict(cone)),                       # diffusion-scale optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_up", dict(up)),

    ("log_tc6", "log", dict(cone), 6.0),            # log(tau_c + 6)
    ("log_tu6", "log", dict(up), 6.0),
    ("log_td6", "log", dict(dn), 6.0),
    ("lg9", "log", {"mu": -2 * G1}, 1 + G1 * G1),   # log(1 + g^2 - 2 g mu), g = 0.9
    ("lgm3", "log", {"mu": -2 * G2}, 1 + G2 * G2),  # g = -0.3
    ("lg8", "log", {"mu": -2 * 0.8}, 1 + 0.64),     # g = 0.8 (forward glow of orders 2-5)
    lin("mu", {"mu": 1.0}),

    lin("vy", {"vy": 1.0}),

    lin("Gv", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 when looking into the cloud from outside
    ("rGv", "relu", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}, 0.0),
    ("logE600", "log", {"E600": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("depth", "relu", {"E150": 2.7}, -0.35),                       # (delta + z0)/z0, z0 = 55 m, delta = 150(E150-0.5)
    ("clos", "relu", {"E300": 2.0}, -1.0),                         # closedness: 0 at a surface, 1 deep inside
    # sky-facing: 1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base;  ground-facing: 1 on bases and flanks, 0 on tops
    ("sky_a", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 + Gup)
    ("sky_b", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(Gup)
    ("gnd_a", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 - Gup)
    ("gnd_b", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(-Gup)
]
add_layer(L1)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 2
A_FR, A_LOBE = 0.3, 1.3      # decay rates (per unit tau_f) of the fresh light and of its build-up
L2 = [
    # direct sun, single scattering: T p(mu) = exp(-tau_f) [0.8 HG(.9) + 0.2 HG(-.3)]  (weights 0.8/0.2 in the output)
    ("dir9", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lg9": -1.5}, hg_const(G1)),
    ("dirm3", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lgm3": -1.5}, hg_const(G2)),

    ("fr_iso", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR}, math.log(0.03)),
    ("fr_back", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lgm3": -1.5}, math.log(0.19) + hg_const(G2)),
    # forward glow 0.39 HG(0.8) (exp(-0.3 tau) - exp(-1.3 tau)): builds up over the first optical depth
    ("lobe_a", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    ("lobe_b", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_LOBE, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    # logs for the products formed in later exp units
    ("log_rGv", "log", {"rGv": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_amu", "log", {"amu": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_depth", "log", {"depth": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_open", "log", {"clos": -1.0}, 1.0 + EPS),                  # log(1 - clos)
    ("log_skyside", "log", {"sky_a": 1.0, "sky_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 + Gup))
    ("log_gndside", "log", {"gnd_a": 1.0, "gnd_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 - Gup))
] + passthru("tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "log_tc6", "log_tu6", "log_td6", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L2)

    ("bvp", "exp", {"log_rGv": 1.0, "log_amu": 1.0}, 0.0),           # relu(Gv) * |mu|  (outflow seen by the camera)
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b",
             "log_depth", "log_open", "log_skyside", "log_gndside",
             "tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "log_tc6", "log_tu6", "log_td6", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 4
# diffuse (orders >= 6) sun light, per unit E_sun: fluence = lit + deep, S = fluence/(4 pi) * boost
A_LIT, LIT_POW600, ALPHA_LIT, BETA_GS = 1.3, 0.6, 0.15, 2.0
K_DEEP, DEEP_POW600, DEEP_TAU_POW = 9.75, 0.3, 1.3
KV, KMU = 0.6, 0.11                        # outflow boost exp(0.6 relu(Gv)|mu|), flow-along-s exp(0.11 mu)
# sky / ground: irradiance on an open surface per unit mean radiance: sky ~ 2.5 L_sky (horizon-bright sky lights
# flanks as much as tops), ground = pi L_gnd on the base, pi/2 on flanks (folded into the 'side' factors).

a_gnd = {"gnd_single": 1.0, "gnd_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "gnd_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
out = []
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sun_{c}", a_sun))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sky_{c}", a_sky))
for c in "RGB":

add_layer(out)

       "_unit_names": [list(n.keys()) for n in names[1:]]}
json.dump(net, open("work/network.json", "w"), indent=1)
n_par = sum(len(l["W"]) * len(l["W"][0]) + len(l["b"]) for l in layers)
print("wrote work/network.json:", len(probes), "probes, layers", [len(l["W"]) for l in layers], n_par, "params")

def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():
            row[prev[k]] += w
        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)
    layers.append({"W": W, "b": b, "act": act})
    names.append(idx)

"""Build work/network.json by reasoning: every weight is a physics formula or a chosen literal.

Run:  ./python3 work/build_network.py
No image is read here.  See work/NETWORK.md for the account of every unit.

Notation (KIT section 4/5): x = sample point, v = view ray direction (camera -> point), s = toward-sun
unit vector, mu = v.s.  The network outputs (a_sun, a_sky, a_gnd) per channel; the renderer multiplies them
by E_sun, L_sky, L_gnd.  All our outputs are grey (the medium is achromatic), so each triple repeats one value.
"""
import json, math

SIG = 0.04                   # sigma_max, 1/m
FOURPI = 4 * math.pi
G1, G2, W1 = 0.9, -0.3, 0.8  # phase function lobes


def hg_const(g):
    """log of the (1-g^2)/(4 pi) prefactor of HG(mu; g)."""
    return math.log((1 - g * g) / FOURPI)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- probes
probes, P = [], {}


def probe(name, spec):
    P[name] = len(probes)
    probes.append(spec)


# (1) fine optical depth toward the sun: midpoint rule on geometrically growing segments.
#     The direct beam only matters for tau < ~6, i.e. the first few hundred metres.
fine_edges = [0, 10, 25, 50, 90, 150, 240, 370, 550]
fine = []
for a, b in zip(fine_edges[:-1], fine_edges[1:]):
    n = f"fine_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": max(b - a, 7)})
    fine.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (2) coarse optical depth toward the sun at the diffusion scale: the blur (>= 150 m, a few transport mean
#     free paths) averages the sun exposure over the neighbourhood that feeds a point by diffusion.
#     Reach 1400 m covers the whole cloud.
cone_edges = [0, 60, 160, 320, 560, 900, 1400]
cone_blur = [150, 200, 280, 380, 500, 700]
cone = []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(cone_edges[:-1], cone_edges[1:]), cone_blur):
    n = f"cone_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    cone.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (3) enclosure: box-filtered density around x at three scales
probe("E150", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 150})
probe("E300", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 300})
probe("E600", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 600})
# (4) large-scale density gradient along the sun direction (cosine of incidence on the lit cap)
probe("s_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("s_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (5) large-scale density gradient along the view ray (am I looking into the cloud from outside?)
probe("v_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("v_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (6) optical depth straight up (sky) and straight down (ground)
ud_edges = [0, 15, 40, 90, 180, 350, 650]
ud_blur = [15, 25, 50, 90, 170, 300]
up, dn = [], []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(ud_edges[:-1], ud_edges[1:]), ud_blur):
    n = f"up_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    up.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
    n = f"dn_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    dn.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (7) vertical large-scale gradient (top surface vs base)
probe("y_below", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("y_above", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (8) scalars
probe("mu", {"type": "cos_view_sun"})
probe("vy", {"type": "view_up"})
probe("one", {"type": "const", "value": 1.0})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer builder
layers = []          # list of dicts with W, b, act
names = [dict(P)]    # name -> index per layer (layer 0 = probes)


def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():
            row[prev[k]] += w
        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)
    layers.append({"W": W, "b": b, "act": act})
    names.append(idx)


def lin(name, ins, bias=0.0):
    return (name, "linear", ins, bias)


def passthru(*ns):
    return [(n, "linear", {n: 1.0}, 0.0) for n in ns]


EPS = 1e-3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 1
GRAD = 300 / (2 * 75)     # (rho(x-d) - rho(x+d)) * blur / (2 d): ~ cos(angle to the surface normal) at a sharp edge
L1 = [
    lin("tau_f", dict(fine)),                       # fine optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_c", dict(cone)),                       # diffusion-scale optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_up", dict(up)),
    lin("tau_dn", dict(dn)),
    ("log_tc", "log", dict(cone), 0.5),             # log(tau_c + 0.5)
    ("log_tu", "log", dict(up), 0.5),
    ("log_td", "log", dict(dn), 0.5),
    ("lg9", "log", {"mu": -2 * G1}, 1 + G1 * G1),   # log(1 + g^2 - 2 g mu), g = 0.9
    ("lgm3", "log", {"mu": -2 * G2}, 1 + G2 * G2),  # g = -0.3
    ("lg8", "log", {"mu": -2 * 0.8}, 1 + 0.64),     # g = 0.8 (forward glow of orders 2-5)
    lin("mu", {"mu": 1.0}),
    ("amu", "abs", {"mu": 1.0}, 0.0),
    lin("vy", {"vy": 1.0}),
    lin("Gs", {"s_minus": GRAD, "s_plus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 on the sun-lit cap, -1 on the far side
    lin("Gv", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 when looking into the cloud from outside
    ("rGv", "relu", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}, 0.0),
    ("logE600", "log", {"E600": 1.0}, EPS),
    # boundary-sink factor: fluence rises inward from a free surface; for the cloud's fuzzy boundary the rise is
    # gentler than the sharp-edged MC shapes' (delta+z0)/z0: 0.64 at E150=0.3, 1 at 0.5, 1.3 at 0.67, 1.9 at 1
    ("depth", "relu", {"E150": 1.8}, 0.1),
    ("clos", "relu", {"E600": 2.0}, -1.0),                         # closedness: 0 at a surface, 1 >= 300 m inside
    # sky-facing: 1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base;  ground-facing: 1 on bases and flanks, 0 on tops
    ("sky_a", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 + Gup)
    ("sky_b", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(Gup)
    ("gnd_a", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 - Gup)
    ("gnd_b", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(-Gup)
]
add_layer(L1)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 2
A_FR, A_LOBE = 0.3, 1.3      # decay rates (per unit tau_f) of the fresh light and of its build-up
L2 = [
    # direct sun, single scattering: T p(mu) = exp(-tau_f) [0.8 HG(.9) + 0.2 HG(-.3)]  (weights 0.8/0.2 in the output)
    ("dir9", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lg9": -1.5}, hg_const(G1)),
    ("dirm3", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lgm3": -1.5}, hg_const(G2)),
    # fresh (orders 1-5): isotropic 0.03 + backscatter lobe 0.19 HG(-0.3), decaying as exp(-0.3 tau_f)
    ("fr_iso", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR}, math.log(0.03)),
    ("fr_back", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lgm3": -1.5}, math.log(0.19) + hg_const(G2)),
    # forward glow 0.39 HG(0.8) (exp(-0.3 tau) - exp(-1.3 tau)): builds up over the first optical depth
    ("lobe_a", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    ("lobe_b", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_LOBE, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    # logs for the products formed in later exp units
    ("log_rGv", "log", {"rGv": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_amu", "log", {"amu": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_depth", "log", {"depth": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_open", "log", {"clos": -1.0}, 1.0 + EPS),                  # log(1 - clos)
    ("log_skyside", "log", {"sky_a": 1.0, "sky_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 + Gup))
    ("log_gndside", "log", {"gnd_a": 1.0, "gnd_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 - Gup))
] + passthru("tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "log_tc6", "log_tu6", "log_td6", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 3
L3 = [
    ("bvp", "exp", {"log_rGv": 1.0, "log_amu": 1.0}, 0.0),           # relu(Gv) * |mu|  (outflow seen by the camera)
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b",
             "log_depth", "log_open", "log_skyside", "log_gndside",
             "tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "log_tc6", "log_tu6", "log_td6", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 4
# diffuse (orders >= 6) sun light, per unit E_sun: fluence = lit + deep, S = fluence/(4 pi) * boost
A_LIT, LIT_POW600, ALPHA_LIT, BETA_GS = 1.3, 0.6, 0.15, 2.0
K_DEEP, DEEP_POW600, DEEP_TAU_POW = 9.75, 0.3, 1.3
KV, KMU = 0.6, 0.11                        # outflow boost exp(0.6 relu(Gv)|mu|), flow-along-s exp(0.11 mu)
# sky / ground: irradiance on an open surface per unit mean radiance: sky ~ 2.5 L_sky (horizon-bright sky lights
# flanks as much as tops), ground = pi L_gnd on the base, pi/2 on flanks (folded into the 'side' factors).
IRR_SKY, IRR_GND = 2.5, math.pi
FLU_PER_IRR = 3.0                           # fluence just inside an open surface lit by an extended source (slab MC)
SIZE_REF = 0.3 ** LIT_POW600                # E600^0.6 of a typical cloud surface point, normalises the lit terms
A_SKY = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_SKY - 1.5) / SIZE_REF      # 1.5: what the sky 'deep' term already gives at the surface
A_GND = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_GND - 1.9) / SIZE_REF
K_SKY, K_GND = K_DEEP * IRR_SKY, K_DEEP * IRR_GND
KV_EXT = 0.5                                # outflow boost for extended sources: exp(0.5 Gv)
SINGLE_HEMI, SINGLE_VY = 0.45, 0.62         # int of p over a hemisphere: 0.84 forward, 0.16 back ~ 0.45 exp(+-0.62 vy)
A_SINGLE = 1.3                               # hemispheric transmittance ~ exp(-1.3 tau) (2 E3(tau))
L4 = [
    ("sun_lit", "exp", {"logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gs": BETA_GS, "tau_c": -ALPHA_LIT, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(A_LIT) - BETA_GS),
    ("sun_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "log_tc6": -DEEP_TAU_POW, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(K_DEEP)),
    ("sky_single", "exp", {"vy": SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "tau_up": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("sky_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_SKY)),
    ("sky_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "log_tu6": -DEEP_TAU_POW, "Gv": KV_EXT},
     math.log(K_SKY)),
    ("gnd_single", "exp", {"vy": -SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "tau_dn": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("gnd_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_GND)),
    ("gnd_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "log_td6": -DEEP_TAU_POW, "Gv": KV_EXT},
     math.log(K_GND)),
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b")
add_layer(L4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- output layer
a_sun = {"dir9": W1, "dirm3": 1 - W1, "fr_iso": 1.0, "fr_back": 1.0, "lobe_a": 1.0, "lobe_b": -1.0,
         "sun_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sun_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_sky = {"sky_single": 1.0, "sky_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sky_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_gnd = {"gnd_single": 1.0, "gnd_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "gnd_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
out = []
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sun_{c}", a_sun))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sky_{c}", a_sky))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_gnd_{c}", a_gnd))
add_layer(out)

net = {"probes": probes, "layers": layers,
       "_unit_names": [list(n.keys()) for n in names[1:]]}
json.dump(net, open("work/network.json", "w"), indent=1)
n_par = sum(len(l["W"]) * len(l["W"][0]) + len(l["b"]) for l in layers)
print("wrote work/network.json:", len(probes), "probes, layers", [len(l["W"]) for l in layers], n_par, "params")
print("A_SKY %.2f K_SKY %.2f A_GND %.2f K_GND %.2f" % (A_SKY, K_SKY, A_GND, K_GND))

"""Build work/network.json by reasoning: every weight is a physics formula or a chosen literal.

Run:  ./python3 work/build_network.py
No image is read here.  See work/NETWORK.md for the account of every unit.

Notation (KIT section 4/5): x = sample point, v = view ray direction (camera -> point), s = toward-sun
unit vector, mu = v.s.  The network outputs (a_sun, a_sky, a_gnd) per channel; the renderer multiplies them
by E_sun, L_sky, L_gnd.  All our outputs are grey (the medium is achromatic), so each triple repeats one value.
"""
import json, math

SIG = 0.04                   # sigma_max, 1/m
FOURPI = 4 * math.pi
G1, G2, W1 = 0.9, -0.3, 0.8  # phase function lobes


def hg_const(g):
    """log of the (1-g^2)/(4 pi) prefactor of HG(mu; g)."""
    return math.log((1 - g * g) / FOURPI)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- probes
probes, P = [], {}


def probe(name, spec):
    P[name] = len(probes)
    probes.append(spec)


# (1) fine optical depth toward the sun: midpoint rule on geometrically growing segments.
#     The direct beam only matters for tau < ~6, i.e. the first few hundred metres.
fine_edges = [0, 10, 25, 50, 90, 150, 240, 370, 550]
fine = []
for a, b in zip(fine_edges[:-1], fine_edges[1:]):
    n = f"fine_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": max(b - a, 7)})
    fine.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (2) coarse optical depth toward the sun at the diffusion scale: the blur (>= 150 m, a few transport mean
#     free paths) averages the sun exposure over the neighbourhood that feeds a point by diffusion.
#     Reach 1400 m covers the whole cloud.
cone_edges = [0, 60, 160, 320, 560, 900, 1400]
cone_blur = [150, 200, 280, 380, 500, 700]
cone = []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(cone_edges[:-1], cone_edges[1:]), cone_blur):
    n = f"cone_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    cone.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (3) enclosure: box-filtered density around x at three scales
probe("E150", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 150})
probe("E300", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 300})
probe("E600", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 600})
# (4) large-scale density gradient along the sun direction (cosine of incidence on the lit cap)
probe("s_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("s_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (5) large-scale density gradient along the view ray (am I looking into the cloud from outside?)
probe("v_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("v_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (6) optical depth straight up (sky) and straight down (ground)
ud_edges = [0, 15, 40, 90, 180, 350, 650]
ud_blur = [15, 25, 50, 90, 170, 300]
up, dn = [], []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(ud_edges[:-1], ud_edges[1:]), ud_blur):
    n = f"up_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    up.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
    n = f"dn_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    dn.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (7) vertical large-scale gradient (top surface vs base)
probe("y_below", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("y_above", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (8) scalars
probe("mu", {"type": "cos_view_sun"})
probe("vy", {"type": "view_up"})
probe("one", {"type": "const", "value": 1.0})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer builder
layers = []          # list of dicts with W, b, act
names = [dict(P)]    # name -> index per layer (layer 0 = probes)


def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():
            row[prev[k]] += w
        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)
    layers.append({"W": W, "b": b, "act": act})
    names.append(idx)


def lin(name, ins, bias=0.0):
    return (name, "linear", ins, bias)


def passthru(*ns):
    return [(n, "linear", {n: 1.0}, 0.0) for n in ns]


EPS = 1e-3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 1
GRAD = 300 / (2 * 75)     # (rho(x-d) - rho(x+d)) * blur / (2 d): ~ cos(angle to the surface normal) at a sharp edge
L1 = [
    lin("tau_f", dict(fine)),                       # fine optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_c", dict(cone)),                       # diffusion-scale optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_up", dict(up)),
    lin("tau_dn", dict(dn)),
    ("log_tc", "log", dict(cone), 0.5),             # log(tau_c + 0.5)
    ("log_tu", "log", dict(up), 0.5),
    ("log_td", "log", dict(dn), 0.5),
    ("lg9", "log", {"mu": -2 * G1}, 1 + G1 * G1),   # log(1 + g^2 - 2 g mu), g = 0.9
    ("lgm3", "log", {"mu": -2 * G2}, 1 + G2 * G2),  # g = -0.3
    ("lg8", "log", {"mu": -2 * 0.8}, 1 + 0.64),     # g = 0.8 (forward glow of orders 2-5)
    lin("mu", {"mu": 1.0}),
    ("amu", "abs", {"mu": 1.0}, 0.0),
    lin("vy", {"vy": 1.0}),
    lin("Gs", {"s_minus": GRAD, "s_plus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 on the sun-lit cap, -1 on the far side
    lin("Gv", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 when looking into the cloud from outside
    ("rGv", "relu", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}, 0.0),
    ("logE600", "log", {"E600": 1.0}, EPS),
    # boundary-sink factor: fluence rises inward from a free surface; for the cloud's fuzzy boundary the rise is
    # gentler than the sharp-edged MC shapes' (delta+z0)/z0: 0.64 at E150=0.3, 1 at 0.5, 1.3 at 0.67, 1.9 at 1
    ("depth", "relu", {"E150": 1.8}, 0.1),
    ("clos", "relu", {"E600": 2.0}, -1.0),                         # closedness: 0 at a surface, 1 >= 300 m inside
    # sky-facing: 1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base;  ground-facing: 1 on bases and flanks, 0 on tops
    ("sky_a", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 + Gup)
    ("sky_b", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(Gup)
    ("gnd_a", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 - Gup)
    ("gnd_b", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(-Gup)
]
add_layer(L1)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 2
A_FR, A_LOBE = 0.3, 1.3      # decay rates (per unit tau_f) of the fresh light and of its build-up
L2 = [
    # direct sun, single scattering: T p(mu) = exp(-tau_f) [0.8 HG(.9) + 0.2 HG(-.3)]  (weights 0.8/0.2 in the output)
    ("dir9", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lg9": -1.5}, hg_const(G1)),
    ("dirm3", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lgm3": -1.5}, hg_const(G2)),
    # fresh (orders 1-5): isotropic 0.03 + backscatter lobe 0.19 HG(-0.3), decaying as exp(-0.3 tau_f)
    ("fr_iso", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR}, math.log(0.03)),
    ("fr_back", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lgm3": -1.5}, math.log(0.19) + hg_const(G2)),
    # forward glow 0.39 HG(0.8) (exp(-0.3 tau) - exp(-1.3 tau)): builds up over the first optical depth
    ("lobe_a", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    ("lobe_b", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_LOBE, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    # logs for the products formed in later exp units
    ("log_rGv", "log", {"rGv": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_amu", "log", {"amu": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_depth", "log", {"depth": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_open", "log", {"clos": -1.0}, 1.0 + EPS),                  # log(1 - clos)
    ("log_skyside", "log", {"sky_a": 1.0, "sky_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 + Gup))
    ("log_gndside", "log", {"gnd_a": 1.0, "gnd_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 - Gup))
    # ((tau + 0.5)/TAU_E)^P_E: the argument of the diffusion decay exp(-(tau/17)^1.6) (see layer 4)
    ("pw_c", "exp", {"log_tc": 1.6}, -1.6 * math.log(17.0)),
    ("pw_u", "exp", {"log_tu": 1.6}, -1.6 * math.log(17.0)),
    ("pw_d", "exp", {"log_td": 1.6}, -1.6 * math.log(17.0)),
] + passthru("tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 3
L3 = [
    ("bvp", "exp", {"log_rGv": 1.0, "log_amu": 1.0}, 0.0),           # relu(Gv) * |mu|  (outflow seen by the camera)
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b",
             "log_depth", "log_open", "log_skyside", "log_gndside", "pw_c", "pw_u", "pw_d",
             "tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 4
# diffuse (orders >= 6) sun light, per unit E_sun: fluence = lit + deep, S = fluence/(4 pi) * boost
A_LIT, LIT_POW600, ALPHA_LIT, BETA_GS = 1.3, 0.6, 0.15, 2.0
# deep: K * depth * E600^0.3 * exp(-((tau_c+0.5)/17)^1.6).  Nearly flat to tau_c ~ 8 (lumpy inter-reflection and
# slab transmission measured in the references and the puck MC), then falls to 0.1 at tau_c ~ 27 (sphere MC).
K_DEEP, DEEP_POW600 = 1.0, 0.3
KV, KMU = 0.6, 0.11                        # outflow boost exp(0.6 relu(Gv)|mu|), flow-along-s exp(0.11 mu)
# sky / ground: irradiance on an open surface per unit mean radiance: sky ~ 2.5 L_sky (horizon-bright sky lights
# flanks as much as tops), ground = pi L_gnd on the base, pi/2 on flanks (folded into the 'side' factors).
IRR_SKY, IRR_GND = 2.5, math.pi
FLU_PER_IRR = 3.0                           # fluence just inside an open surface lit by an extended source (slab MC)
SIZE_REF = 0.3 ** LIT_POW600                # E600^0.6 of a typical cloud surface point, normalises the lit terms
K_SKY, K_GND = 3.5, 4.4                     # deep terms: ~0.25 of the surface fluence transmitted through tau ~ 10
A_SKY = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_SKY - 0.7 * K_SKY) / SIZE_REF   # 0.7 K: what the deep term already gives at the surface
A_GND = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_GND - 0.7 * K_GND) / SIZE_REF
KV_EXT = 0.5                                # outflow boost for extended sources: exp(0.5 Gv)
SINGLE_HEMI, SINGLE_VY = 0.45, 0.62         # int of p over a hemisphere: 0.84 forward, 0.16 back ~ 0.45 exp(+-0.62 vy)
A_SINGLE = 1.3                               # hemispheric transmittance ~ exp(-1.3 tau) (2 E3(tau))
L4 = [
    ("sun_lit", "exp", {"logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gs": BETA_GS, "tau_c": -ALPHA_LIT, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(A_LIT) - BETA_GS),
    ("sun_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_c": -1.0, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(K_DEEP)),
    ("sky_single", "exp", {"vy": SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "tau_up": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("sky_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_SKY)),
    ("sky_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_u": -1.0, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(K_SKY)),
    ("gnd_single", "exp", {"vy": -SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "tau_dn": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("gnd_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_GND)),
    ("gnd_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_d": -1.0, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(K_GND)),
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b")
add_layer(L4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- output layer
a_sun = {"dir9": W1, "dirm3": 1 - W1, "fr_iso": 1.0, "fr_back": 1.0, "lobe_a": 1.0, "lobe_b": -1.0,
         "sun_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sun_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_sky = {"sky_single": 1.0, "sky_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sky_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_gnd = {"gnd_single": 1.0, "gnd_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "gnd_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
out = []
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sun_{c}", a_sun))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sky_{c}", a_sky))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_gnd_{c}", a_gnd))
add_layer(out)

net = {"probes": probes, "layers": layers,
       "_unit_names": [list(n.keys()) for n in names[1:]]}
json.dump(net, open("work/network.json", "w"), indent=1)
n_par = sum(len(l["W"]) * len(l["W"][0]) + len(l["b"]) for l in layers)
print("wrote work/network.json:", len(probes), "probes, layers", [len(l["W"]) for l in layers], n_par, "params")
print("A_SKY %.2f K_SKY %.2f A_GND %.2f K_GND %.2f" % (A_SKY, K_SKY, A_GND, K_GND))

"""Build work/network.json by reasoning: every weight is a physics formula or a chosen literal.

Run:  ./python3 work/build_network.py
No image is read here.  See work/NETWORK.md for the account of every unit.

Notation (KIT section 4/5): x = sample point, v = view ray direction (camera -> point), s = toward-sun
unit vector, mu = v.s.  The network outputs (a_sun, a_sky, a_gnd) per channel; the renderer multiplies them
by E_sun, L_sky, L_gnd.  All our outputs are grey (the medium is achromatic), so each triple repeats one value.
"""
import json, math

SIG = 0.04                   # sigma_max, 1/m
FOURPI = 4 * math.pi
G1, G2, W1 = 0.9, -0.3, 0.8  # phase function lobes


def hg_const(g):
    """log of the (1-g^2)/(4 pi) prefactor of HG(mu; g)."""
    return math.log((1 - g * g) / FOURPI)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- probes
probes, P = [], {}


def probe(name, spec):
    P[name] = len(probes)
    probes.append(spec)


# (1) fine optical depth toward the sun: midpoint rule on geometrically growing segments.
#     The direct beam only matters for tau < ~6, i.e. the first few hundred metres.
fine_edges = [0, 10, 25, 50, 90, 150, 240, 370, 550]
fine = []
for a, b in zip(fine_edges[:-1], fine_edges[1:]):
    n = f"fine_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": max(b - a, 7)})
    fine.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (2) coarse optical depth toward the sun at the diffusion scale: the blur (>= 150 m, a few transport mean
#     free paths) averages the sun exposure over the neighbourhood that feeds a point by diffusion.
#     Reach 1400 m covers the whole cloud.
cone_edges = [0, 60, 160, 320, 560, 900, 1400]
cone_blur = [150, 200, 280, 380, 500, 700]
cone = []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(cone_edges[:-1], cone_edges[1:]), cone_blur):
    n = f"cone_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    cone.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (3) enclosure: box-filtered density around x at three scales
probe("E150", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 150})
probe("E300", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 300})
probe("E600", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 600})
# (4) large-scale density gradient along the sun direction (cosine of incidence on the lit cap)
probe("s_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("s_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (5) large-scale density gradient along the view ray (am I looking into the cloud from outside?)
probe("v_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("v_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (6) optical depth straight up (sky) and straight down (ground)
ud_edges = [0, 15, 40, 90, 180, 350, 650]
ud_blur = [15, 25, 50, 90, 170, 300]
up, dn = [], []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(ud_edges[:-1], ud_edges[1:]), ud_blur):
    n = f"up_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    up.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
    n = f"dn_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    dn.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (7) vertical large-scale gradient (top surface vs base)
probe("y_below", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("y_above", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (8) scalars
probe("mu", {"type": "cos_view_sun"})
probe("vy", {"type": "view_up"})
probe("one", {"type": "const", "value": 1.0})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer builder
layers = []          # list of dicts with W, b, act
names = [dict(P)]    # name -> index per layer (layer 0 = probes)


def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():
            row[prev[k]] += w
        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)
    layers.append({"W": W, "b": b, "act": act})
    names.append(idx)


def lin(name, ins, bias=0.0):
    return (name, "linear", ins, bias)


def passthru(*ns):
    return [(n, "linear", {n: 1.0}, 0.0) for n in ns]


EPS = 1e-3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 1
GRAD = 300 / (2 * 75)     # (rho(x-d) - rho(x+d)) * blur / (2 d): ~ cos(angle to the surface normal) at a sharp edge
L1 = [
    lin("tau_f", dict(fine)),                       # fine optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_c", dict(cone)),                       # diffusion-scale optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_up", dict(up)),
    lin("tau_dn", dict(dn)),
    ("log_tf", "log", dict(fine), 0.01),            # log(tau_f + 0.01), for the tau e^-0.55 tau glow build-up
    ("log_tc", "log", dict(cone), 0.5),             # log(tau_c + 0.5)
    ("log_tu", "log", dict(up), 0.5),
    ("log_td", "log", dict(dn), 0.5),
    ("lg9", "log", {"mu": -2 * G1}, 1 + G1 * G1),   # log(1 + g^2 - 2 g mu), g = 0.9
    ("lgm3", "log", {"mu": -2 * G2}, 1 + G2 * G2),  # g = -0.3
    ("lg8", "log", {"mu": -2 * 0.8}, 1 + 0.64),     # g = 0.8 (forward glow of orders 2-5)
    lin("mu", {"mu": 1.0}),
    ("amu", "abs", {"mu": 1.0}, 0.0),
    lin("vy", {"vy": 1.0}),
    lin("Gs", {"s_minus": GRAD, "s_plus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 on the sun-lit cap, -1 on the far side
    lin("Gv", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 when looking into the cloud from outside
    ("rGv", "relu", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}, 0.0),
    ("logE600", "log", {"E600": 1.0}, EPS),
    # boundary-sink factor: fluence rises inward from a free surface; for the cloud's fuzzy boundary the rise is
    # gentler than the sharp-edged MC shapes' (delta+z0)/z0: 0.64 at E150=0.3, 1 at 0.5, 1.3 at 0.67, 1.9 at 1
    ("depth", "relu", {"E150": 1.8}, 0.1),
    ("clos", "relu", {"E600": 2.0}, -1.0),                         # closedness: 0 at a surface, 1 >= 300 m inside
    # sky-facing: 1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base;  ground-facing: 1 on bases and flanks, 0 on tops
    ("sky_a", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 + Gup)
    ("sky_b", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(Gup)
    ("gnd_a", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 - Gup)
    ("gnd_b", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(-Gup)
]
add_layer(L1)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 2
A_FR, A_LOBE = 0.3, 1.3      # decay rates (per unit tau_f) of the fresh light and of its build-up
L2 = [
    # direct sun, single scattering: T p(mu) = exp(-tau_f) [0.8 HG(.9) + 0.2 HG(-.3)]  (weights 0.8/0.2 in the output)
    ("dir9", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lg9": -1.5}, hg_const(G1)),
    ("dirm3", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lgm3": -1.5}, hg_const(G2)),
    # fresh (orders 1-5): isotropic 0.03 + backscatter lobe 0.19 HG(-0.3), decaying as exp(-0.3 tau_f)
    ("fr_iso", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR}, math.log(0.03)),
    ("fr_back", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lgm3": -1.5}, math.log(0.19) + hg_const(G2)),
    # forward glow 0.39 HG(0.8) (exp(-0.3 tau) - exp(-1.3 tau)): builds up over the first optical depth
    ("lobe_a", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    ("lobe_b", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_LOBE, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(0.39) + hg_const(0.8)),
    # logs for the products formed in later exp units
    ("log_rGv", "log", {"rGv": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_amu", "log", {"amu": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_depth", "log", {"depth": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_open", "log", {"clos": -1.0}, 1.0 + EPS),                  # log(1 - clos)
    ("log_skyside", "log", {"sky_a": 1.0, "sky_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 + Gup))
    ("log_gndside", "log", {"gnd_a": 1.0, "gnd_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 - Gup))
    # ((tau + 0.5)/TAU_E)^P_E: the argument of the diffusion decay exp(-(tau/17)^1.6) (see layer 4)
    ("pw_c", "exp", {"log_tc": 1.6}, -1.6 * math.log(17.0)),
    ("pw_u", "exp", {"log_tu": 1.6}, -1.6 * math.log(17.0)),
    ("pw_d", "exp", {"log_td": 1.6}, -1.6 * math.log(17.0)),
] + passthru("tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 3
L3 = [
    ("bvp", "exp", {"log_rGv": 1.0, "log_amu": 1.0}, 0.0),           # relu(Gv) * |mu|  (outflow seen by the camera)
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b",
             "log_depth", "log_open", "log_skyside", "log_gndside", "pw_c", "pw_u", "pw_d",
             "tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 4
# diffuse (orders >= 6) sun light, per unit E_sun: fluence = lit + deep, S = fluence/(4 pi) * boost
A_LIT, LIT_POW600, ALPHA_LIT, BETA_GS = 1.3, 0.6, 0.15, 2.0
# deep: K * depth * E600^0.3 * exp(-((tau_c+0.5)/17)^1.6).  Nearly flat to tau_c ~ 8 (lumpy inter-reflection and
# slab transmission measured in the references and the puck MC), then falls to 0.1 at tau_c ~ 27 (sphere MC).
K_DEEP, DEEP_POW600 = 1.0, 0.3
KV, KMU = 0.6, 0.11                        # outflow boost exp(0.6 relu(Gv)|mu|), flow-along-s exp(0.11 mu)
# sky / ground: irradiance on an open surface per unit mean radiance: sky ~ 2.5 L_sky (horizon-bright sky lights
# flanks as much as tops), ground = pi L_gnd on the base, pi/2 on flanks (folded into the 'side' factors).
IRR_SKY, IRR_GND = 2.5, math.pi
FLU_PER_IRR = 3.0                           # fluence just inside an open surface lit by an extended source (slab MC)
SIZE_REF = 0.3 ** LIT_POW600                # E600^0.6 of a typical cloud surface point, normalises the lit terms
K_SKY, K_GND = 3.5, 4.4                     # deep terms: ~0.25 of the surface fluence transmitted through tau ~ 10
A_SKY = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_SKY - 0.7 * K_SKY) / SIZE_REF   # 0.7 K: what the deep term already gives at the surface
A_GND = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_GND - 0.7 * K_GND) / SIZE_REF
KV_EXT = 0.5                                # outflow boost for extended sources: exp(0.5 Gv)
SINGLE_HEMI, SINGLE_VY = 0.45, 0.62         # int of p over a hemisphere: 0.84 forward, 0.16 back ~ 0.45 exp(+-0.62 vy)
A_SINGLE = 1.3                               # hemispheric transmittance ~ exp(-1.3 tau) (2 E3(tau))

    ("sun_lit", "exp", {"logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gs": BETA_GS, "tau_c": -ALPHA_LIT, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(A_LIT) - BETA_GS),
    ("sun_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_c": -1.0, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(K_DEEP)),
    ("sky_single", "exp", {"vy": SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "tau_up": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("sky_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_SKY)),
    ("sky_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_u": -1.0, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(K_SKY)),
    ("gnd_single", "exp", {"vy": -SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "tau_dn": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("gnd_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_GND)),
    ("gnd_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_d": -1.0, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(K_GND)),
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b")
add_layer(L4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- output layer
a_sun = {"dir9": W1, "dirm3": 1 - W1, "fr_iso": 1.0, "fr_back": 1.0, "lobe_a": 1.0, "lobe_b": -1.0,
         "sun_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sun_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_sky = {"sky_single": 1.0, "sky_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sky_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_gnd = {"gnd_single": 1.0, "gnd_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "gnd_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
out = []
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sun_{c}", a_sun))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sky_{c}", a_sky))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_gnd_{c}", a_gnd))
add_layer(out)

net = {"probes": probes, "layers": layers,
       "_unit_names": [list(n.keys()) for n in names[1:]]}
json.dump(net, open("work/network.json", "w"), indent=1)
n_par = sum(len(l["W"]) * len(l["W"][0]) + len(l["b"]) for l in layers)
print("wrote work/network.json:", len(probes), "probes, layers", [len(l["W"]) for l in layers], n_par, "params")

"""Build work/network.json by reasoning: every weight is a physics formula or a chosen literal.

Run:  ./python3 work/build_network.py
No image is read here.  See work/NETWORK.md for the account of every unit.

Notation (KIT section 4/5): x = sample point, v = view ray direction (camera -> point), s = toward-sun
unit vector, mu = v.s.  The network outputs (a_sun, a_sky, a_gnd) per channel; the renderer multiplies them
by E_sun, L_sky, L_gnd.  All our outputs are grey (the medium is achromatic), so each triple repeats one value.

SIG = 0.04                   # sigma_max, 1/m
FOURPI = 4 * math.pi
G1, G2, W1 = 0.9, -0.3, 0.8  # phase function lobes


def hg_const(g):
    """log of the (1-g^2)/(4 pi) prefactor of HG(mu; g)."""
    return math.log((1 - g * g) / FOURPI)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- probes
probes, P = [], {}


def probe(name, spec):
    P[name] = len(probes)
    probes.append(spec)


# (1) fine optical depth toward the sun: midpoint rule on geometrically growing segments.
#     The direct beam only matters for tau < ~6, i.e. the first few hundred metres.
fine_edges = [0, 10, 25, 50, 90, 150, 240, 370, 550]
fine = []
for a, b in zip(fine_edges[:-1], fine_edges[1:]):
    n = f"fine_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": max(b - a, 7)})
    fine.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (2) coarse optical depth toward the sun at the diffusion scale: the blur (>= 150 m, a few transport mean
#     free paths) averages the sun exposure over the neighbourhood that feeds a point by diffusion.
#     Reach 1400 m covers the whole cloud.
cone_edges = [0, 60, 160, 320, 560, 900, 1400]
cone_blur = [150, 200, 280, 380, 500, 700]
cone = []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(cone_edges[:-1], cone_edges[1:]), cone_blur):
    n = f"cone_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    cone.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (3) enclosure: box-filtered density around x at three scales
probe("E150", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 150})
probe("E300", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 300})
probe("E600", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 600})
# (4) large-scale density gradient along the sun direction (cosine of incidence on the lit cap)
probe("s_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("s_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (5) large-scale density gradient along the view ray (am I looking into the cloud from outside?)
probe("v_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("v_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (6) optical depth straight up (sky) and straight down (ground)
ud_edges = [0, 15, 40, 90, 180, 350, 650]
ud_blur = [15, 25, 50, 90, 170, 300]
up, dn = [], []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(ud_edges[:-1], ud_edges[1:]), ud_blur):
    n = f"up_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    up.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
    n = f"dn_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    dn.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (7) vertical large-scale gradient (top surface vs base)
probe("y_below", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("y_above", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (8) scalars
probe("mu", {"type": "cos_view_sun"})
probe("vy", {"type": "view_up"})
probe("one", {"type": "const", "value": 1.0})

layers = []          # list of dicts with W, b, act
names = [dict(P)]    # name -> index per layer (layer 0 = probes)


def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():

        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)
    layers.append({"W": W, "b": b, "act": act})

    lin("tau_c", dict(cone)),                       # diffusion-scale optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_up", dict(up)),
    lin("tau_dn", dict(dn)),
    ("log_tf", "log", dict(fine), 0.01),            # log(tau_f + 0.01), for the tau e^-0.55 tau glow build-up
    ("log_tc", "log", dict(cone), 0.5),             # log(tau_c + 0.5)
    ("log_tu", "log", dict(up), 0.5),
    ("log_td", "log", dict(dn), 0.5),
    ("lg9", "log", {"mu": -2 * G1}, 1 + G1 * G1),   # log(1 + g^2 - 2 g mu), g = 0.9
    ("lgm3", "log", {"mu": -2 * G2}, 1 + G2 * G2),  # g = -0.3
    ("lg8", "log", {"mu": -2 * 0.8}, 1 + 0.64),     # g = 0.8 (forward glow of orders 2-5)
    lin("mu", {"mu": 1.0}),
    ("amu", "abs", {"mu": 1.0}, 0.0),
    lin("vy", {"vy": 1.0}),
    lin("Gs", {"s_minus": GRAD, "s_plus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 on the sun-lit cap, -1 on the far side
    lin("Gv", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 when looking into the cloud from outside
    ("rGv", "relu", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}, 0.0),
    ("logE600", "log", {"E600": 1.0}, EPS),
    # boundary-sink factor: fluence rises inward from a free surface; for the cloud's fuzzy boundary the rise is

    ("clos", "relu", {"E600": 2.0}, -1.0),                         # closedness: 0 at a surface, 1 >= 300 m inside
    # sky-facing: 1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base;  ground-facing: 1 on bases and flanks, 0 on tops
    ("sky_a", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 + Gup)
    ("sky_b", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(Gup)
    ("gnd_a", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 - Gup)
    ("gnd_b", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(-Gup)

"""Build work/network.json by reasoning: every weight is a physics formula or a chosen literal.

Run:  ./python3 work/build_network.py
No image is read here.  See work/NETWORK.md for the account of every unit.

Notation (KIT section 4/5): x = sample point, v = view ray direction (camera -> point), s = toward-sun
unit vector, mu = v.s.  The network outputs (a_sun, a_sky, a_gnd) per channel; the renderer multiplies them
by E_sun, L_sky, L_gnd.  All our outputs are grey (the medium is achromatic), so each triple repeats one value.
"""
import json, math

SIG = 0.04                   # sigma_max, 1/m
FOURPI = 4 * math.pi
G1, G2, W1 = 0.9, -0.3, 0.8  # phase function lobes


def hg_const(g):
    """log of the (1-g^2)/(4 pi) prefactor of HG(mu; g)."""
    return math.log((1 - g * g) / FOURPI)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- probes
probes, P = [], {}


def probe(name, spec):
    P[name] = len(probes)
    probes.append(spec)


# (1) fine optical depth toward the sun: midpoint rule on geometrically growing segments.
#     The direct beam only matters for tau < ~6, i.e. the first few hundred metres.
fine_edges = [0, 10, 25, 50, 90, 150, 240, 370, 550]
fine = []
for a, b in zip(fine_edges[:-1], fine_edges[1:]):
    n = f"fine_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": max(b - a, 7)})
    fine.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (2) coarse optical depth toward the sun at the diffusion scale: the blur (>= 150 m, a few transport mean
#     free paths) averages the sun exposure over the neighbourhood that feeds a point by diffusion.
#     Reach 1400 m covers the whole cloud.
cone_edges = [0, 60, 160, 320, 560, 900, 1400]
cone_blur = [150, 200, 280, 380, 500, 700]
cone = []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(cone_edges[:-1], cone_edges[1:]), cone_blur):
    n = f"cone_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    cone.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (3) enclosure: box-filtered density around x at three scales
probe("E150", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 150})
probe("E300", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 300})
probe("E600", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0, "blur": 600})
# (4) large-scale density gradient along the sun direction (cosine of incidence on the lit cap)
probe("s_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("s_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "light", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (5) large-scale density gradient along the view ray (am I looking into the cloud from outside?)
probe("v_plus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("v_minus", {"type": "density", "frame": "view", "dir": [-1, 0, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (6) optical depth straight up (sky) and straight down (ground)
ud_edges = [0, 15, 40, 90, 180, 350, 650]
ud_blur = [15, 25, 50, 90, 170, 300]
up, dn = [], []
for (a, b), bl in zip(zip(ud_edges[:-1], ud_edges[1:]), ud_blur):
    n = f"up_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    up.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
    n = f"dn_{a}_{b}"
    probe(n, {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 0.5 * (a + b), "blur": bl})
    dn.append((n, SIG * (b - a)))
# (7) vertical large-scale gradient (top surface vs base)
probe("y_below", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, -1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
probe("y_above", {"type": "density", "frame": "world", "dir": [0, 1, 0], "dist": 75, "blur": 300})
# (8) scalars
probe("mu", {"type": "cos_view_sun"})
probe("vy", {"type": "view_up"})
probe("one", {"type": "const", "value": 1.0})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer builder
layers = []          # list of dicts with W, b, act
names = [dict(P)]    # name -> index per layer (layer 0 = probes)


def add_layer(units):
    """units: list of (name, act, {input_name: weight}, bias)."""
    prev = names[-1]
    W, b, act, idx = [], [], [], {}
    for name, a, ins, bias in units:
        row = [0.0] * len(prev)
        for k, w in ins.items():
            row[prev[k]] += w
        W.append(row); b.append(bias); act.append(a); idx[name] = len(idx)
    layers.append({"W": W, "b": b, "act": act})
    names.append(idx)


def lin(name, ins, bias=0.0):
    return (name, "linear", ins, bias)


def passthru(*ns):
    return [(n, "linear", {n: 1.0}, 0.0) for n in ns]


EPS = 1e-3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 1
GRAD = 300 / (2 * 75)     # (rho(x-d) - rho(x+d)) * blur / (2 d): ~ cos(angle to the surface normal) at a sharp edge
L1 = [
    lin("tau_f", dict(fine)),                       # fine optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_c", dict(cone)),                       # diffusion-scale optical depth toward the sun
    lin("tau_up", dict(up)),
    lin("tau_dn", dict(dn)),
    ("log_tf", "log", dict(fine), 0.01),            # log(tau_f + 0.01), for the tau e^-0.55 tau glow build-up
    ("log_tc", "log", dict(cone), 0.5),             # log(tau_c + 0.5)
    ("log_tu", "log", dict(up), 0.5),
    ("log_td", "log", dict(dn), 0.5),
    ("lg9", "log", {"mu": -2 * G1}, 1 + G1 * G1),   # log(1 + g^2 - 2 g mu), g = 0.9
    ("lgm3", "log", {"mu": -2 * G2}, 1 + G2 * G2),  # g = -0.3
    ("lg8", "log", {"mu": -2 * 0.8}, 1 + 0.64),     # g = 0.8 (forward glow of orders 2-5)
    lin("mu", {"mu": 1.0}),
    ("amu", "abs", {"mu": 1.0}, 0.0),
    lin("vy", {"vy": 1.0}),
    lin("Gs", {"s_minus": GRAD, "s_plus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 on the sun-lit cap, -1 on the far side
    lin("Gv", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}),                 # +1 when looking into the cloud from outside
    ("rGv", "relu", {"v_plus": GRAD, "v_minus": -GRAD}, 0.0),
    ("logE600", "log", {"E600": 1.0}, EPS),
    # boundary-sink factor: fluence rises inward from a free surface; for the cloud's fuzzy boundary the rise is
    # gentler than the sharp-edged MC shapes' (delta+z0)/z0: 0.64 at E150=0.3, 1 at 0.5, 1.3 at 0.67, 1.9 at 1
    ("depth", "relu", {"E150": 1.8}, 0.1),
    ("clos", "relu", {"E600": 2.0}, -1.0),                         # closedness: 0 at a surface, 1 >= 300 m inside
    # sky-facing: 1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base;  ground-facing: 1 on bases and flanks, 0 on tops
    ("sky_a", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 + Gup)
    ("sky_b", "relu", {"y_below": GRAD, "y_above": -GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(Gup)
    ("gnd_a", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 1.0),   # relu(1 - Gup)
    ("gnd_b", "relu", {"y_below": -GRAD, "y_above": GRAD}, 0.0),   # relu(-Gup)
]
add_layer(L1)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 2
A_FR = 0.3                   # decay rate (per unit tau_f) of the fresh light's broad part
C_LOBE, A_LOBE = 0.52, 0.55  # forward glow: 0.52 HG(mu; 0.8) tau_f exp(-0.55 tau_f)  (slab MC, orders 1-5 at mu = 1)
L2 = [
    # direct sun, single scattering: T p(mu) = exp(-tau_f) [0.8 HG(.9) + 0.2 HG(-.3)]  (weights 0.8/0.2 in the output)
    ("dir9", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lg9": -1.5}, hg_const(G1)),
    ("dirm3", "exp", {"tau_f": -1.0, "lgm3": -1.5}, hg_const(G2)),
    # fresh (orders 1-5): isotropic 0.03 + backscatter lobe 0.19 HG(-0.3), decaying as exp(-0.3 tau_f)
    ("fr_iso", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR}, math.log(0.03)),
    ("fr_back", "exp", {"tau_f": -A_FR, "lgm3": -1.5}, math.log(0.19) + hg_const(G2)),
    # forward glow of the low orders: builds up linearly, peaks at tau_f ~ 1.8, dies by tau_f ~ 12
    ("lobe", "exp", {"log_tf": 1.0, "tau_f": -A_LOBE, "lg8": -1.5}, math.log(C_LOBE) + hg_const(0.8)),
    # logs for the products formed in later exp units
    ("log_rGv", "log", {"rGv": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_amu", "log", {"amu": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_depth", "log", {"depth": 1.0}, EPS),
    ("log_open", "log", {"clos": -1.0}, 1.0 + EPS),                  # log(1 - clos)
    ("log_skyside", "log", {"sky_a": 1.0, "sky_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 + Gup))
    ("log_gndside", "log", {"gnd_a": 1.0, "gnd_b": -1.0}, EPS),      # log(min(1, 1 - Gup))
    # ((tau + 0.5)/TAU_E)^P_E: the argument of the diffusion decay exp(-((tau+0.5)/16)^1.8) (see layer 4)
    ("pw_c", "exp", {"log_tc": P_E}, -P_E * math.log(TAU_E)),
    ("pw_u", "exp", {"log_tu": P_E}, -P_E * math.log(TAU_E)),
    ("pw_d", "exp", {"log_td": P_E}, -P_E * math.log(TAU_E)),
] + passthru("tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 3
L3 = [
    ("bvp", "exp", {"log_rGv": 1.0, "log_amu": 1.0}, 0.0),           # relu(Gv) * |mu|  (outflow seen by the camera)
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe",
             "log_depth", "log_open", "log_skyside", "log_gndside", "pw_c", "pw_u", "pw_d",
             "tau_c", "tau_up", "tau_dn", "mu", "vy", "Gs", "Gv", "logE600")
add_layer(L3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- layer 4
# diffuse (orders >= 6) sun light, per unit E_sun: fluence = lit + deep, S = fluence/(4 pi) * boost
A_LIT, LIT_POW600, ALPHA_LIT, BETA_GS = 1.3, 0.6, 0.15, 2.0
# deep: K * depth * E600^0.3 * exp(-((tau_c+0.5)/16)^1.8).  Nearly flat to tau_c ~ 8 (lumpy inter-reflection and
# slab transmission measured in the references and the puck MC), 0.17 at tau_c = 22, 0.07 at 27 (sphere MC).
K_DEEP, DEEP_POW600 = 1.0, 0.3
KV, KMU = 0.6, 0.11                        # outflow boost exp(0.6 relu(Gv)|mu|), flow-along-s exp(0.11 mu)
# sky / ground: irradiance on an open surface per unit mean radiance: sky ~ 2.5 L_sky (horizon-bright sky lights
# flanks as much as tops), ground = pi L_gnd on the base, pi/2 on flanks (folded into the 'side' factors).
IRR_SKY, IRR_GND = 2.5, math.pi
FLU_PER_IRR = 3.0                           # fluence just inside an open surface lit by an extended source (slab MC)
SIZE_REF = 0.3 ** LIT_POW600                # E600^0.6 of a typical cloud surface point, normalises the lit terms
K_SKY, K_GND = 3.5, 4.4                     # deep terms: ~0.25 of the surface fluence transmitted through tau ~ 10
A_SKY = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_SKY - 0.7 * K_SKY) / SIZE_REF   # 0.7 K: what the deep term already gives at the surface
A_GND = (FLU_PER_IRR * IRR_GND - 0.7 * K_GND) / SIZE_REF
KV_EXT = 0.5                                # outflow boost for extended sources: exp(0.5 Gv)
SINGLE_HEMI, SINGLE_VY = 0.45, 0.62         # int of p over a hemisphere: 0.84 forward, 0.16 back ~ 0.45 exp(+-0.62 vy)
A_SINGLE = 1.3                               # hemispheric transmittance ~ exp(-1.3 tau) (2 E3(tau))
L4 = [
    ("sun_lit", "exp", {"logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gs": BETA_GS, "tau_c": -ALPHA_LIT, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(A_LIT) - BETA_GS),
    ("sun_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_c": -1.0, "bvp": KV, "mu": KMU},
     math.log(K_DEEP)),
    ("sky_single", "exp", {"vy": SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "tau_up": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("sky_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_skyside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_SKY)),
    ("sky_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_u": -1.0, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(K_SKY)),
    ("gnd_single", "exp", {"vy": -SINGLE_VY, "log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "tau_dn": -A_SINGLE},
     math.log(SINGLE_HEMI)),
    ("gnd_lit", "exp", {"log_open": 1.0, "log_gndside": 1.0, "logE600": LIT_POW600, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(A_GND)),
    ("gnd_deep", "exp", {"log_depth": 1.0, "logE600": DEEP_POW600, "pw_d": -1.0, "Gv": KV_EXT}, math.log(K_GND)),
] + passthru("dir9", "dirm3", "fr_iso", "fr_back", "lobe_a", "lobe_b")
add_layer(L4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- output layer
a_sun = {"dir9": W1, "dirm3": 1 - W1, "fr_iso": 1.0, "fr_back": 1.0, "lobe_a": 1.0, "lobe_b": -1.0,
         "sun_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sun_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_sky = {"sky_single": 1.0, "sky_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "sky_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
a_gnd = {"gnd_single": 1.0, "gnd_lit": 1 / FOURPI, "gnd_deep": 1 / FOURPI}
out = []
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sun_{c}", a_sun))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_sky_{c}", a_sky))
for c in "RGB":
    out.append(lin(f"a_gnd_{c}", a_gnd))
add_layer(out)

net = {"probes": probes, "layers": layers,
       "_unit_names": [list(n.keys()) for n in names[1:]]}
json.dump(net, open("work/network.json", "w"), indent=1)
n_par = sum(len(l["W"]) * len(l["W"][0]) + len(l["b"]) for l in layers)
print("wrote work/network.json:", len(probes), "probes, layers", [len(l["W"]) for l in layers], n_par, "params")
print("A_SKY %.2f K_SKY %.2f A_GND %.2f K_GND %.2f" % (A_SKY, K_SKY, A_GND, K_GND))

input.content:
# NETWORK.md: a hand-written light-transport network for the cumulus renderer

Rebuild: `./python3 work/build_network.py` (writes `work/network.json`; reads no image).

Every weight in `network.json` is either a physics formula (phase-function prefactors, extinction × segment
lengths, logs of chosen constants) or a literal chosen by reasoning in `build_network.py`. Nothing was fitted.
The numbers were chosen from (a) the medium's physics, (b) my own Monte Carlo simulations of this medium in
slabs, spheres and a puck (`work/mc.py`, `work/mc_puck.py`, results in `work/mc_out/`), and (c) looking at my
renders beside the references and at linear block averages (`work/measure.py`) and `./inspect` traces.

## 1. What the network computes

The renderer needs, at every sample point x, `S = a_sun·E_sun + a_sky·L_sky + a_gnd·L_gnd`, the phase-weighted
radiance arriving at x. The medium is grey, so every `a` is the same in R, G and B; all colour comes from the
renderer's multiplication by `E_sun`, `L_sky`, `L_gnd`.

Per unit irradiance the network models

```
a_sun = T_sun·p(μ)                         direct sun, single scattering (exact form)
      + e^{-0.3 τ_f}·[0.03 + 0.19·HG(μ;-0.3)]   "fresh" light, scattering orders 1-5, broad part
      + 0.52·HG(μ;0.8)·τ_f·e^{-0.55 τ_f}         "fresh" forward glow (silver lining, light seen from below)
      + (Φ_lit + Φ_deep)/(4π)·B(v)            multiply scattered (orders ≥ 6) light, a fluence over 4π
a_sky = 0.45 e^{+0.62 v_y}·open·skyside·e^{-1.3 τ_up}  + (Φ_sky,lit + Φ_sky,deep)/(4π)·e^{0.5 G_v}
a_gnd = 0.45 e^{-0.62 v_y}·open·gndside·e^{-1.3 τ_dn}  + (Φ_gnd,lit + Φ_gnd,deep)/(4π)·e^{0.5 G_v}
```

with

```
Φ_lit   = 1.3·E600^0.6·e^{2(G_s-1)}·e^{-0.15 τ_c}                      light injected locally on the sun-lit cap
Φ_deep  = 1.0·depth·E600^0.3·exp(-((τ_c+0.5)/16)^1.8)                  light diffused through the body
B(v)    = e^{0.6·relu(G_v)·|μ| + 0.11 μ}                                  view dependence of the diffuse light
Φ_sky,lit  = 5.35·open·skyside·E600^0.6,   Φ_sky,deep = 7.0·depth·E600^0.3·exp(-((τ_up+0.5)/16)^1.8)
Φ_gnd,lit  = 10.8·open·gndside·E600^0.6,   Φ_gnd,deep = 6.0·depth·E600^0.3·exp(-((τ_dn+0.5)/16)^1.8)
```

Features (all from density probes, section 2): `τ_f` fine optical depth toward the sun, `τ_c` diffusion-scale
optical depth toward the sun, `τ_up`, `τ_dn` optical depths straight up / down, `E150/E300/E600` the density
box-filtered over cubes of 150/300/600 m at x, `G_s` the large-scale density gradient along the sun direction
(≈ cosine of incidence on the lit cap, −1 on the far side), `G_v` the same along the view ray (+1 when looking
into the cloud from outside), `G_up` along world up (+1 on tops, −1 on the base), `depth = relu(1.8 E150 + 0.1)`,
`open = 1 − relu(2 E600 − 1)`, `skyside = min(1, 1+G_up)`, `gndside = min(1, 1−G_up)`.

## 2. Probes (38)

| # | probe | role |
|---|---|---|
| 0–7 | light frame, dir +s, dist = midpoints of segments [0,10],[10,25],[25,50],[50,90],[90,150],[150,240],[240,370],[370,550] m, blur = segment length | `τ_f = σ Σ len·d` by the midpoint rule; the direct beam matters only for τ < 6 |
| 8–13 | light frame, dir +s, segments [0,60],[60,160],[160,320],[320,560],[560,900],[900,1400], blurs 150,200,280,380,500,700 | `τ_c`: the optical depth toward the sun averaged over the neighbourhood that feeds x by diffusion (a few transport mean free paths ≈ 150–300 m) |
| 14,15,16 | world frame, dist 0, blur 150 / 300 / 600 | enclosure `E150`, `E300` (unused now), `E600` |
| 17,18 | light frame, dir −s / +s, dist 75, blur 300 | `G_s = 2(ρ(x−75s) − ρ(x+75s))` (= blur/(2·dist) × difference) |
| 19,20 | view frame, dir +v / −v, dist 75, blur 300 | `G_v = 2(ρ(x+75v) − ρ(x−75v))` |
| 21–26 | world up, segments [0,15],[15,40],[40,90],[90,180],[180,350],[350,650], blurs 15,25,50,90,170,300 | `τ_up` |
| 27–32 | world down, same | `τ_dn` |
| 33,34 | world down / up, dist 75, blur 300 | `G_up = 2(ρ(x−75ŷ) − ρ(x+75ŷ))` |
| 35 | cos_view_sun | μ |
| 36 | view_up | v_y |
| 37 | const 1 | bias carrier (unused by weights; kept for clarity) |

## 3. Layers, unit by unit

Layer 1 (24 units, from probes)
- `tau_f`, `tau_c`, `tau_up`, `tau_dn` (linear): σ_max × segment length × probe, summed.
- `log_tf = log(τ_f + 0.01)`, `log_tc = log(τ_c + 0.5)`, `log_tu`, `log_td` (log): logs for later products/powers.
- `lg9 = log(1 + 0.81 − 1.8μ)`, `lgm3 = log(1 + 0.09 + 0.6μ)`, `lg8 = log(1 + 0.64 − 1.6μ)` (log): the HG
  denominators for g = 0.9, −0.3, 0.8; `HG(μ;g) = exp(log((1−g²)/4π) − 1.5·lg)`.
- `mu` (linear), `amu = |μ|` (abs), `vy` (linear).
- `Gs`, `Gv` (linear), `rGv = relu(G_v)`.
- `logE600 = log(E600 + 1e-3)`.
- `depth = relu(1.8·E150 + 0.1)`: the fluence rises inward from a free surface (boundary sink, extrapolation
  length z0 ≈ 55 m); for the cloud's fuzzy boundary the rise is gentler than the MC's (δ+z0)/z0.
- `clos = relu(2·E600 − 1)`: 0 at any surface, 1 when > 300 m inside.
- `sky_a = relu(1+G_up)`, `sky_b = relu(G_up)`, `gnd_a = relu(1−G_up)`, `gnd_b = relu(−G_up)`: pieces of
  `skyside = sky_a − sky_b` (1 on tops and flanks, 0 on the base) and `gndside = gnd_a − gnd_b`.

Layer 2 (22 units)
- `dir9 = e^{-τ_f}·HG(μ;0.9)`, `dirm3 = e^{-τ_f}·HG(μ;−0.3)`: the exact single scattering, combined 0.8/0.2 in the output.
- `fr_iso = 0.03 e^{-0.3τ_f}`, `fr_back = 0.19 e^{-0.3τ_f} HG(μ;−0.3)`: the broad part of orders 1–5. From the slab
  MC: orders 1–5 ≈ 0.065 at the surface for μ=−1, decaying ≈ e^{-0.3τ}; the backscatter lobe of the phase
  function survives the first scatterings (0.034 at μ=−0.5 vs 0.065 at μ=−1 in the 60° slab).
- `lobe = 0.52·HG(μ;0.8)·τ_f·e^{-0.55τ_f}`: the forward glow of orders 1–5 at μ≈1 in the slab MC is 0.43, 1.17,
  1.25, 0.83, 0.52, 0.11, 0.002 at τ = 0.2, 1, 1.8, 3.4, 5, 9.8, 13; τe^{-0.55τ}×1.86 gives 0.33, 1.1, 1.27, 0.99,
  0.61, 0.085, 0.019. Its angular width matches HG(0.8) (ratios 1 : 0.08 : 0.01 at μ = 1, 0.866, 0.5).
- `log_rGv`, `log_amu`, `log_depth`, `log_open = log(1 − clos)`, `log_skyside`, `log_gndside` (log): logs of the
  factors multiplied inside later exp units.
- `pw_c = ((τ_c+0.5)/16)^1.8`, `pw_u`, `pw_d` (exp of 1.8·log): the argument of the diffusion decay.
- pass-through (linear ×1): `tau_c, tau_up, tau_dn, mu, vy, Gs, Gv, logE600`.

Layer 3 (21 units)
- `bvp = exp(log_rGv + log_amu) = relu(G_v)·|μ|`: the product that drives the outflow boost (see B(v)).
- pass-throughs of everything needed later.

Layer 4 (13 units; each exp unit is a product of powers of the features)
- `sun_lit = 1.3·E600^0.6·e^{2(G_s−1)}·e^{-0.15τ_c}·e^{0.6 bvp + 0.11μ}`
- `sun_deep = depth·E600^0.3·e^{-pw_c}·e^{0.6 bvp + 0.11μ}`
- `sky_single = 0.45 e^{0.62 v_y}·open·skyside·e^{-1.3τ_up}`, `gnd_single = 0.45 e^{-0.62 v_y}·open·gndside·e^{-1.3τ_dn}`
- `sky_lit = 5.35·open·skyside·E600^0.6·e^{0.5G_v}`, `sky_deep = 7·depth·E600^0.3·e^{-pw_u}·e^{0.5G_v}`
- `gnd_lit = 10.8·open·gndside·E600^0.6·e^{0.5G_v}`, `gnd_deep = 6·depth·E600^0.3·e^{-pw_d}·e^{0.5G_v}`
- pass-throughs of `dir9, dirm3, fr_iso, fr_back, lobe`.

# NETWORK.md: a hand-written light-transport network for the cumulus renderer

Rebuild: `./python3 work/build_network.py` (writes `work/network.json`; reads no image).

Every weight in `network.json` is either a physics formula (phase-function prefactors, extinction × segment
lengths, logs of chosen constants) or a literal chosen by reasoning in `build_network.py`. Nothing was fitted.
The numbers were chosen from (a) the medium's physics, (b) my own Monte Carlo simulations of this medium in
slabs, spheres and a puck (`work/mc.py`, `work/mc_puck.py`, results in `work/mc_out/`), and (c) looking at my
renders beside the references and at linear block averages (`work/measure.py`) and `./inspect` traces.

## 1. What the network computes

The renderer needs, at every sample point x, `S = a_sun·E_sun + a_sky·L_sky + a_gnd·L_gnd`, the phase-weighted
radiance arriving at x. The medium is grey, so every `a` is the same in R, G and B; all colour comes from the
renderer's multiplication by `E_sun`, `L_sky`, `L_gnd`.

Per unit irradiance the network models

```
a_sun = T_sun·p(μ)                         direct sun, single scattering (exact form)
      + e^{-0.3 τ_f}·[0.03 + 0.19·HG(μ;-0.3)]   "fresh" light, scattering orders 1-5, broad part
      + 0.52·HG(μ;0.8)·τ_f·e^{-0.55 τ_f}         "fresh" forward glow (silver lining, light seen from below)
      + (Φ_lit + Φ_deep)/(4π)·B(v)            multiply scattered (orders ≥ 6) light, a fluence over 4π
a_sky = 0.45 e^{+0.62 v_y}·open·skyside·e^{-1.3 τ_up}  + (Φ_sky,lit + Φ_sky,deep)/(4π)·e^{0.5 G_v}
a_gnd = 0.45 e^{-0.62 v_y}·open·gndside·e^{-1.3 τ_dn}  + (Φ_gnd,lit + Φ_gnd,deep)/(4π)·e^{0.5 G_v}
```

with

```
Φ_lit   = 1.3·E600^0.6·e^{2(G_s-1)}·e^{-0.15 τ_c}                      light injected locally on the sun-lit cap
Φ_deep  = 1.0·depth·E600^0.3·exp(-((τ_c+0.5)/16)^1.8)                  light diffused through the body
B(v)    = e^{0.6·relu(G_v)·|μ| + 0.11 μ}                                  view dependence of the diffuse light
Φ_sky,lit  = 5.35·open·skyside·E600^0.6,   Φ_sky,deep = 7.0·depth·E600^0.3·exp(-((τ_up+0.5)/16)^1.8)
Φ_gnd,lit  = 10.8·open·gndside·E600^0.6,   Φ_gnd,deep = 6.0·depth·E600^0.3·exp(-((τ_dn+0.5)/16)^1.8)
```

(≈ cosine of incidence on the lit cap, −1 on the far side), `G_v` the same along the view ray (+1 when looking
into the cloud from outside), `G_up` along world up (+1 on tops, −1 on the base), `depth = relu(1.8 E150 + 0.1)`,

| # | probe | role |
|---|---|---|
| 0–7 | light frame, dir +s, dist = midpoints of segments [0,10],[10,25],[25,50],[50,90],[90,150],[150,240],[240,370],[370,550] m, blur = segment length | `τ_f = σ Σ len·d` by the midpoint rule; the direct beam matters only for τ < 6 |
| 8–13 | light frame, dir +s, segments [0,60],[60,160],[160,320],[320,560],[560,900],[900,1400], blurs 150,200,280,380,500,700 | `τ_c`: the optical depth toward the sun averaged over the neighbourhood that feeds x by diffusion (a few transport mean free paths ≈ 150–300 m) |
| 14,15,16 | world frame, dist 0, blur 150 / 300 / 600 | enclosure `E150`, `E300` (unused now), `E600` |
| 17,18 | light frame, dir −s / +s, dist 75, blur 300 | `G_s = 2(ρ(x−75s) − ρ(x+75s))` (= blur/(2·dist) × difference) |
| 19,20 | view frame, dir +v / −v, dist 75, blur 300 | `G_v = 2(ρ(x+75v) − ρ(x−75v))` |
| 21–26 | world up, segments [0,15],[15,40],[40,90],[90,180],[180,350],[350,650], blurs 15,25,50,90,170,300 | `τ_up` |
| 27–32 | world down, same | `τ_dn` |
| 33,34 | world down / up, dist 75, blur 300 | `G_up = 2(ρ(x−75ŷ) − ρ(x+75ŷ))` |
| 35 | cos_view_sun | μ |
| 36 | view_up | v_y |
| 37 | const 1 | bias carrier (unused by weights; kept for clarity) |

Layer 1 (24 units, from probes)

- `log_tf = log(τ_f + 0.01)`, `log_tc = log(τ_c + 0.5)`, `log_tu`, `log_td` (log): logs for later products/powers.
- `lg9 = log(1 + 0.81 − 1.8μ)`, `lgm3 = log(1 + 0.09 + 0.6μ)`, `lg8 = log(1 + 0.64 − 1.6μ)` (log): the HG
  denominators for g = 0.9, −0.3, 0.8; `HG(μ;g) = exp(log((1−g²)/4π) − 1.5·lg)`.
- `mu` (linear), `amu = |μ|` (abs), `vy` (linear).
